title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
abstract: arXiv:2609.39601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. translated_title: GroundingPI：一个基于视觉原语、面向物理智能的视觉定位基础模型
translated_abstract: 精确的视觉定位至关重要。它需要指明哪个物体是目标以及该物体位于何处，即使在杂乱场景和微小物体的情况下也必须准确，并且必须足够快速以支持闭环控制。然而，视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）通常从通用的视觉-语言骨干网络和视频生成骨干网络获取感知能力，而这些骨干网络在上述场景中仍然表现不佳。我们提出了GroundingPI，一个40亿参数的视觉定位基础模型，它以共享词表中的量化坐标形式生成点和边界框。其训练结合了多模态与空间预训练、监督微调以及基于GRPO的强化学习，并利用公开数据集和专用数据引擎提供监督信号。在与涵盖11种感知能力的34个视觉定位基准上的44个基线模型的对比中，GroundingPI确立了新的最先进水平，平均成绩达到73.68%，超过了参数量更大的GPT-6 Astra（71.54%）。作为下游任务的视觉骨干网络，GroundingPI提升了……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: GroundingPI是一个40亿参数的视觉定位基础模型，它将点和框表示为共享词表中的量化坐标，并通过多模态与空间预训练、监督微调及GRPO强化学习训练而成，在11种感知能力的34个基准测试上以平均73.68%的成绩超越更大的GPT-6 Astra，创下新的最先进水平，为物理智能提供了快速精确的视觉感知基础。
en_tdlr: GroundingPI is a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary, trained with multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement learning, achieving a new state-of-the-art average of 73.68% across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities and surpassing the larger GPT-6 Astra, thus providing fast and precise visual perception for physical intelligence.
